assertions.assertion: Implements ITokenRequestCustomizer interface with a Customize method
assertions.rationale: Never uses ITokenRequestCustomizer; proposes manual parameter overrides and a custom DelegatingHandler instead.

assertions.assertion: The Customize method accepts HttpRequestMessage, TokenRequestParameters, and CancellationToken
assertions.rationale: No Customize method exists; the DelegatingHandler uses SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage, CancellationToken) instead.

assertions.assertion: Uses the 'with' expression or equivalent to create modified TokenRequestParameters (e.g., setting Resource or Scope per tenant)
assertions.rationale: Constructs new UserTokenRequestParameters { Scope = cfg.RequiredScopes, Resource = cfg.ApiResource } per tenant, an equivalent way to set per-tenant Resource/Scope.

assertions.assertion: Passes the customizer instance to AddClientCredentialsTokenHandler or AddUserAccessTokenHandler
assertions.rationale: No customizer is passed to any Add*Handler; registration uses a generic AddHttpMessageHandler with a hand-rolled handler.
